versions.changelog:
- Initial release of qwen-wan-video skill.
- Supports direct use of Alibaba Cloud Qwen Wan 2.6 text-to-video and image-to-video generation, without a proxy API.
- Enables creation of short, high-quality videos from text prompts or images, with professional controls for parameters like depth of field and camera movement.
- Handles long-running tasks asynchronously, including automatic polling and result retrieval.
- Includes clear environment configuration steps and usage examples in Python.
